Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.provider

Class ExternalRailProviderConfiguration

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.provider.ExternalRailProviderConfiguration
@Configuration("kfeExternalRailProviderConfiguration") public class ExternalRailProviderConfiguration extends Object
Selects external Lightning invoice/payment providers from configured beans and operator preference. Automatic selection follows the declared LND, BTCPay, configurable-provider priority.

      @Bean("kfeExternalLightningInvoiceGateway") @ConditionalOnMissingBean(name="kfeExternalLightningInvoiceGateway") public LightningInvoiceGateway kfeExternalLightningInvoiceGateway(org.springframework.core.env.Environment environment, @Qualifier("kfeLndRestLightningClient") org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<LndRestLightningClient> lndRestGateway, @Qualifier("kfeBtcpayCustodyGateway") org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<BtcPayServerCustodyGateway> btcpayGateway, @Qualifier("kfeConfigurableCustodyGateway") org.springframework.beans.factory.ObjectProvider<ConfigurableCustodyGateway> configurableGateway)
      Registers the selected invoice gateway, using the configured provider key or automatic priority.
      Parameters:
      environment - Spring property source for invoice provider selection
      lndRestGateway - optional LND invoice/payment implementation
      btcpayGateway - optional BTCPay invoice implementation
      configurableGateway - optional configured custody invoice implementation
      Returns:
      selected Lightning invoice provider
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - when the requested provider is absent or no automatic candidate exists
